analysis.purpose: The test suite for semantic-delta — it defines the behaviour that is guaranteed, so a change that breaks any of it fails the build. It pins: EnrichmentStore.semanticDelta — classification (read-only, default); EnrichmentStore.semanticDelta — prune + generation bump; EnrichmentStore.semanticDelta — targets filter; semantic_delta → enrich_next({targets}) re-issue path.
responsibilities: Pin the observable behaviour of semantic-delta
Fail the build when a guaranteed behaviour changes
